versions.content: Setting of useSecuredPduHeader attribute The useSe- curedPduHeader shall be set to a value other than noHeader if the length of the payload Pdu is dynamic and is transmitted directly over a network which may insert padding bytes depending on the length (e.g. CANFD, Flexray).
